import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import numpy as np, mujoco, rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R, Slerp
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image

class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=rcb_dtb.Session(); self.m=self.s.model;self.d=self.s.data
  self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m); self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  self.hand=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.jq=self.s._jq;self.jv=self.s._jv
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));self.jr=self.jp.copy()
 def pose(self):return self.d.xpos[self.hand].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.hand].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,pos,rot,q=None):
  if q is None:q=self.s.targets[:7].copy()
  else:q=q.copy()
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  for it in range(60):
   self.k.qpos[self.jq[:7]]=q;mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k);mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
   p=self.k.xpos[self.hand];mat=self.k.xmat[self.hand].reshape(3,3)
   e=np.r_[pos-p,R.from_matrix(rot@mat.T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e[:3])<1e-5 and np.linalg.norm(e[3:])<1e-4:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.hand)
   J=np.vstack([self.jp[:,self.jv[:7]],self.jr[:,self.jv[:7]]])
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   q=np.clip(q+np.clip(dq,-.12,.12),self.s.lower[:7]+.001,self.s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def move(self,pos,rot,hand=None,steps=120):
  if hand is None:hand=self.s.targets[7:].copy()
  p0,r0=self.pose();h0=self.s.targets[7:].copy()
  sl=Slerp([0,1],R.from_matrix([r0,rot]))
  for i in range(steps):
   t=(i+1)/steps;t=t*t*(3-2*t)
   q=self.ik(p0+(pos-p0)*t,sl(t).as_matrix())
   self.s.step(np.r_[q,h0+(hand-h0)*t])
 def hold(self,n=120):
  for _ in range(n):self.s.step(self.s.targets)
 def snap(self,name):
  Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
 def report(self):
  print('state',self.s.state(),'progress',self.s.progress(),flush=True)
  for ci in range(self.d.ncon):
   c=self.d.contact[ci];g1=self.m.geom(c.geom1).name;g2=self.m.geom(c.geom2).name
   if g1.startswith('object') or g2.startswith('object'):
    ff=np.zeros(6);mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.m,self.d,ci,ff)
    print('contact',g1,g2, np.round(c.pos,4),np.round(ff[:3],3),flush=True)

class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s = rcb_dtb.Session('/app/instance.json')
        self.m, self.d = self.s.model, self.s.data
        self.k = mujoco.MjData(self.m)  # Separate data for kinematic calculations.
        self.k.qpos[:] = self.d.qpos
        self.hand = self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
        self.jq, self.jv = self.s._jq, self.s._jv
        self.jp = np.zeros((3, self.m.nv))
        self.jr = self.jp.copy()

    def pose(self):
        return (self.d.xpos[self.hand].copy(),
                self.d.xmat[self.hand].reshape(3, 3).copy())

    def ik(self, pos, rot, q=None):
        q = self.s.targets[:7].copy() if q is None else q.copy()
        self.k.qpos[:] = self.d.qpos
        for _ in range(60):
            self.k.qpos[self.jq[:7]] = q
            mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m, self.k)
            mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m, self.k)
            p = self.k.xpos[self.hand]
            mat = self.k.xmat[self.hand].reshape(3, 3)
            e = np.r_[pos - p, R.from_matrix(rot @ mat.T).as_rotvec()]
            if np.linalg.norm(e[:3]) < 1e-5 and np.linalg.norm(e[3:]) < 1e-4:
                break
            mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m, self.k, self.jp, self.jr, self.hand)
            J = np.vstack([self.jp[:, self.jv[:7]], self.jr[:, self.jv[:7]]])
            dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + np.eye(6) * 1e-5, e)
            q = np.clip(q + np.clip(dq, -.12, .12),
                        self.s.lower[:7] + .001, self.s.upper[:7] - .001)
        return q

    def move(self, pos, rot, hand=None, steps=120):
        if hand is None:
            hand = self.s.targets[7:].copy()
        p0, r0 = self.pose()
        h0 = self.s.targets[7:].copy()
        sl = Slerp([0, 1], R.from_matrix([r0, rot]))
        for i in range(steps):
            t = (i + 1) / steps
            t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
            q = self.ik(p0 + (pos - p0) * t, sl(t).as_matrix())
            self.s.step(np.r_[q, h0 + (hand - h0) * t])

        for _ in range(n):

            if np.linalg.norm(rv) > rcap:

            q = self.ik(op + dp + dr @ (hp - op), dr @ hr, st['q'][:7])
            s.step(np.r_[q, hand])

    dr = R.from_rotvec([-.3, 0, 0]).as_matrix()
    c.move(op + dr @ (hp - op), dr @ hr, hand, 120)
    hp, hr = c.pose()
    c.move(hp + [0, 0, .13], hr, hand, 180)
    c.hold(60)

    hand = s.targets[7:].copy()
